message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
PROJECT=SUPRA
MISSION=CANNONICO_FAST_LOCAL_MATERIALIZE_V1
MODE=EXECUTE_LOCAL_ONLY
PRIORITY=IMMEDIATE
NO_DOWNLOAD=YES
NO_GIT_FETCH=YES
NO_CI_WAIT=YES
NO_BUILD_SUPRA=YES
NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
NO_NEW_UPDATER=YES
NO_HUMAN_RELAY=YES

PURPOSE:
Materialize the desktop launcher immediately without waiting for the slow bootstrap.
This mission installs no repository code and therefore MUST NOT wait for canonical CI.

EXISTING_ASSETS:
UPDATER=$HOME/Library/Application Support/NOVA ERA/SUPRA Updater/supra_autobuild_self_update.sh
CANONICAL_APP=$HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app
TARGET=$HOME/Desktop/CAnnoNico.app

DO NOW:
1) STOP/IGNORE any duplicate bootstrap work for this launcher mission. Do not kill unrelated Codex/Ollama work.
2) Require only that UPDATER exists and is executable.
3) Create TARGET locally with /usr/bin/osacompile as a small AppleScript application.
4) Launcher click semantics MUST be:
   - wait while $HOME/Library/Application Support/NOVA ERA/SUPRA Updater/update.lock exists;
   - run /bin/bash on the EXISTING UPDATER synchronously;
   - wait again for update.lock to clear;
   - require CANONICAL_APP exists;
   - open ONLY CANONICAL_APP.
5) Set CFBundleName/CFBundleDisplayName=CAnnoNico and CFBundleIdentifier=com.novaera.cannonico-launcher.
6) Remove quarantine attribute from TARGET if present.
7) Verify TARGET/Contents/Info.plist and TARGET/Contents/MacOS/applet exist.
8) Do NOT trigger a SUPRA rebuild merely to create this launcher.
9) Do NOT ask Nicolas for Terminal.

If SUPRA is currently closed, leave it closed after materializing the launcher; Nicolas may click CAnnoNico himself.
If SUPRA is running, do not disturb it.

RETURN EXACTLY:
STATUS=PASS|FAIL_BOUNDED
CANNONICO_APP=$HOME/Desktop/CAnnoNico.app
CANNONICO_EXISTS=YES|NO
BUNDLE_ID=
UPDATER_EXISTS=YES|NO
SUPRA_DISTURBED=NO
ACTION_NICOLAS=NONE|CLICK_CANNONICO_ONCE
